prompt:
Hey — before we kick off the database migration next week I need our OpenClaw workspace fully protected. Here's what I need done:

1. Create a permanent, migration-safe snapshot of the current workspace that will never be automatically cleaned up by any future maintenance runs.

2. Run an audit showing what old backup files would be deleted under our standard retention policy (keep everything from the last 24 hours, one-per-day for the past week, one-per-week for the past month) — but don't actually delete anything. Save the output to a file named `prune_dry_run.txt`.

3. Set up automated recurring backups using that same standard retention policy so the workspace is protected going forward without anyone having to remember to run it manually.

Please make sure you're using whatever the official backup tooling is — I don't want any one-off scripts cobbled together.
